title: 第十三章 孟子有云 非人也第十三章 孟子有云 非人也
lines: 砰！
林砚搬起院子里的石凳，狠狠砸在周武脑袋上，血花四溅。
确认周武死透了，他才开始摸尸。
“堂堂黑虎帮堂主，这么穷？”
摸了半天，只有一块刻着“黑虎”二字的银牌，林砚忍不住骂了一句。
这银牌倒有五六两重，但杂质太多，且他不可能拿去当铺换钱。
没再管周武的尸体，林砚进了屋。屋子铺着地砖，陈设简单，只有一套桌凳和一张床。
他目光一寸寸扫过去，最后落在床底。
掀开床板，地面干干净净。
林砚笑了。
周武这种人不可能打扫床底，干净得反常，必然有蹊跷。
一番摸索，果然发现一块地砖是空心的。
两指顺着缝隙插入，猛地一掀，地砖翻开，露出下面的木盒。
打开木盒，雪白的银光映在脸上。
“这么多银子……难道是黑虎帮的藏钱据点？还是周武的私藏？”
林砚两眼放光。不管是谁的，现在都归他了。
拿起几锭银子端详片刻，他更满意了，这是市面上流通的普通银锭，没有黑虎帮的标记，花出去毫无风险。
“走水了！”
深夜，院子火光冲天。
等火被扑灭，几道身影面色难看地站在废墟前。
“帮主，周堂主是被拳头打死的。可惜尸体烧毁了，看不出是哪家拳法。”
黑虎帮帮主面色铁青。
这处院子是帮里的秘密据点，知晓此处的只有他自己，连其他堂主都不知情。
周武被人偷袭受伤，仇家不少，他才安排周武住在这里，给周武送吃食的都是最底层的帮众，按理不会引人注意。
“还能是哪家？咱们黑虎帮就那么三家仇人，肯定是其中一家干的。”
另一位堂主冷冷道：“依我看，是有人盯上了送饭的帮众，一路跟过来的。那个叫郑波的家伙死了，正好说明问题——敌人是尾随他找上门的。”
“郑波？家里还有老母和弟弟？”
黑虎帮帮主淡淡道：“勾栏那边最近缺兔儿，把他弟弟送过去。”
林砚趁着婶婶不在家，将银子藏好，换下身上的衣服，拿出去烧掉。
“我衣服本就不多，这么下去要没得穿了，得去裁缝铺多做几套。”
杀一次人，烧一套衣服。
要不是每次都有收获，他连杀人都快杀不起了。
和上次一样，林砚开始复盘。
首先反省：自己小觑了一次磨皮的强大。
content_en:
Bang!
Lin Yan picked up the stone bench in the yard and hit Zhou Wu on the head hard, causing blood to splash everywhere.
After confirming that Zhou Wu was completely dead, he began to touch the body.
"The dignified leader of the Black Tiger Gang is so poor?"
After touching for a long time, there was only a silver medal with the word "Black Tiger" engraved on it. Lin Yan couldn't help but curse.
The silver medal was of five or six weight, but there were too many impurities, and it was impossible for him to exchange it for money at a pawn shop.
Ignoring Zhou Wu's body, Lin Yan entered the room. The room was paved with tiles and simply furnished, with only a set of tables and stools and a bed.
His eyes swept over inch by inch, and finally landed on the bottom of the bed.
Lifting the bed board, the floor was clean.
Lin Yan smiled.
It is impossible for a person like Zhou Wu to clean the bottom of the bed. If it is abnormally clean, there must be something fishy.
After some exploration, I found that one of the floor tiles was hollow.
Two fingers were inserted along the gap, and with a sudden lift, the floor tiles were opened, revealing the wooden box underneath.
Opening the wooden box, the snow-white silver light reflected on his face.
"Such a lot of money... could it be the money hiding place of the Black Tiger Gang? Or is it Zhou Wu's private collection?"
Lin Yan's eyes shone. No matter whose it was, it belongs to him now.
After picking up a few ingots of silver and looking at them for a moment, he was even more satisfied. They were ordinary silver ingots circulating in the market, without the mark of the Black Tiger Gang, and there was no risk in spending them.
…
"It's gone!"
Late at night, the yard was ablaze.
When the fire was extinguished, several figures stood in front of the ruins with ugly expressions.
"Gang leader, Hall Leader Zhou was beaten to death by fists. Unfortunately, the body was burned, so we can't tell which boxing method he belonged to."
The leader of the Black Tiger Gang looked livid.
This courtyard is a secret stronghold of the gang. He is the only one who knows about it, not even the other hall leaders.
Zhou Wu was injured in a sneak attack and had many enemies, so he arranged for Zhou Wu to live here. Those who brought food to Zhou Wu were all the lowest-level gang members, so they would not attract anyone's attention.
"Who else could it be? There are only three enemies of our Black Tiger Gang. One of them must have done it."
Another hall leader said coldly: "In my opinion, someone is eyeing the gang members who delivered the food and followed them all the way. The fact that the guy named Zheng Bo is dead just illustrates the problem - the enemy followed him to the door."
"Zheng Bo? Do you still have your mother and younger brother at home?"
"Yes."
The leader of the Black Tiger Gang said calmly: "There is a shortage of rabbits at Goulan recently. Send his brother over."
…
Taking advantage of his aunt's absence, Lin Yan hid the money, changed out of his clothes, and took them out to burn.
"I don't have many clothes. If this keeps going on, I won't have anything to wear. I have to go to a tailor shop to make a few more sets."
Kill one person and burn a set of clothes.
If he didn't get something every time, he would hardly be able to kill anyone.
Like last time, Lin Yan began to review.
First of all, reflect on this: I underestimated the power of microdermabrasion.
